title.en: Dictionary Basics: Create, Read, Update, Delete

blurb.en: A dictionary maps keys to values: look a value up by its key, add or change it by assigning, and take it out again with del or pop.
blurb.zh: 字典把键映射到值：按键查值，赋值就是新增或修改，用 del 或 pop 再把它拿掉。

en: A dictionary is written as key: value pairs inside curly braces. Square brackets with a key read the value stored under it. Asking for a key that is not there is an error - a KeyError - so the program catches it and prints just the name of the exception.

get is the gentle way to read: a missing key gives None, or the default you pass as the second argument, instead of an error. in asks about keys only - pears is a key, so the answer is True, but 5 is only a value, so the answer is False.

Assigning to d[key] does two jobs. If the key is new, the pair is added at the end; if the key is already there, only its value changes and it keeps its place. That is why apples still comes first when report lists the stock, even though it was updated after plums was added: a dictionary remembers the order its keys were first put in.

There are two ways to take an entry out. del is a statement that removes it and hands nothing back. pop is a method that removes it and hands the value back, so you can keep it. keys(), values() and items() let you walk the keys, the values, or both at once, always in that same insertion order.
zh: 字典写成花括号里的一组组 键: 值。方括号里放一个键，读出存在它下面的值。要一个不存在的键是错误——KeyError——所以程序接住它，只打印异常的名字。
get 是温和的读法：键不存在时交回 None，或者你作为第二个实参传进去的缺省值，而不是报错。in 只问键——pears 是键，所以得到 True；5 只是一个值，所以得到 False。
给 d[key] 赋值一次做两件事。键是新的，这一对就加在末尾；键已经存在，只改它的值、位置不动。所以虽然 apples 是在 plums 加进来之后才更新的，report 列出库存时它仍然排第一：字典记住的是每个键第一次放进去的顺序。
拿掉一项有两种写法。del 是一条语句，删掉就完，什么也不交回。pop 是一个方法，删掉的同时把值交回来，你可以留着用。keys()、values()、items() 让你分别走遍键、值、或者两者一起，顺序始终是插入顺序。

lineNotes.en: The same missing key read twice with get: once with no default, once with 0.
lineNotes.zh: 同一个不存在的键用 get 读两次：一次不给缺省值，一次给 0。

lineNotes.en: apples is already a key, so this changes its value and leaves it where it was.
lineNotes.zh: apples 已经是键，所以这一行只改它的值，位置不变。

run.expect:
12
missing: KeyError
None 0
True False
  apples 10
  pears 5
  plums 8
8 {'apples': 10}
['apples'] [10]

title.zh: 词频统计：先用 in 判断

blurb.en: Count how often each word appears by asking, for every word, whether it already has a count.
blurb.zh: 数每个词出现几次：对每个词都先问一句——它已经有计数了吗？

en: A dictionary makes a natural tally: each word is a key and its count is the value. The loop visits the words one at a time, and each word falls into one of two cases. If it is already a key, its count goes up by one. If it is not, it is added with a count of 1.

The two cases are needed because reading counts[word] for a word that is not there yet is a KeyError - you cannot add one to a count that does not exist. The in test is what keeps the program away from that error. in on a dictionary checks the keys, and it is fast however big the dictionary gets.
The words come out in the order each one was first met, because a dictionary keeps its keys in insertion order. An empty list never enters the loop and gives an empty dictionary.

The same problem is solved three ways on this page: Word Count: Test with in, Word Count: get with a Default and Word Count: collections.Counter. Put them side by side to see how the two-case if shrinks.
zh: 字典天生适合做计数表：每个词是一个键，它的次数是值。循环逐个看这些词，每个词只会落进两种情形之一：已经是键了，计数加一；还不是，就以计数 1 加进去。
之所以要分两种情形，是因为对一个还不存在的词读 counts[word] 会抛 KeyError——不存在的计数没法加一。in 这一判断正是让程序躲开这个错误的那一道关。in 对字典查的是键，而且不管字典多大都很快。
词按各自第一次出现的顺序排列，因为字典按插入顺序保存键。空列表根本不进循环，得到空字典。
本页用三种写法解同一个问题：「词频统计：先用 in 判断」「词频统计：get 带缺省值」「词频统计：collections.Counter」。把它们并排放，看这个两支的 if 是怎么缩下去的。

lineNotes.en: First time this word is met: it becomes a key with a count of 1.
lineNotes.zh: 第一次遇到这个词：它成为一个键，计数为 1。

title.en: Word Count: get with a Default
title.zh: 词频统计：get 带缺省值

blurb.en: The same tally in one line per word: read the count with a default of 0, add one, store it back.
blurb.zh: 同一张计数表，每个词只要一行：带缺省值 0 读出计数，加一，写回去。

en: get(key, default) hands back the value stored under key, or default if the key is not there. With a default of 0 a new word and an old word look the same: both have a current count - 0 for a new one - so both can simply have 1 added to it.

That removes the need for the if and else in Word Count: Test with in. The right-hand side is worked out first, using the old count, and only then is the result stored under the key, adding it if it is new.
The result is exactly the same dictionary, in the same order, as the other two versions of this problem: Word Count: Test with in and Word Count: collections.Counter.
zh: get(key, default) 交回存在 key 下面的值；键不存在就交回 default。缺省值取 0 之后，新词和老词看起来就一样了：两者都有一个当前计数——新词是 0——所以都只需加 1。
这样就用不着「词频统计：先用 in 判断」里的 if 和 else 了。等号右边先用旧计数算出来，然后才把结果存到这个键下面——键是新的就顺带加进去。
结果与这个问题的另外两个版本——「词频统计：先用 in 判断」「词频统计：collections.Counter」——是完全相同的字典，顺序也相同。

lineNotes.en: An empty list never enters the loop, so this hands back an empty dictionary.
lineNotes.zh: 空列表不进循环，所以这里交回一个空字典。

blurb.en: The standard library already has a dictionary made for counting: hand Counter a list and it does the whole tally.
blurb.zh: 标准库里早就有专门用来计数的字典：把列表交给 Counter，整张计数表它一次做完。

en: Counter lives in the collections module. Given any sequence, it counts every item and stores the counts as a dictionary: each item is a key and its count is the value, in the order the items were first met.

It behaves like a dictionary with two extras. Asking for a key it has never seen gives 0 instead of a KeyError - dog is not in the text, and counts["dog"] is simply 0. And most_common(n) hands back the n most frequent items as a list of (item, count) pairs, highest first; items with equal counts keep the order in which they were first met. In this text only the occurs more than once (3 times), so the top two are ('the', 3) and ('cat', 1): cat is the first of the words that occur once.

word_count wraps the Counter in dict(...) so that it hands back an ordinary dictionary, exactly like Word Count: Test with in and Word Count: get with a Default. A Counter and a dict holding the same pairs compare equal, but they are different types, and a function that promises a dict should hand back a dict.
zh: Counter 在 collections 模块里。给它任何一个序列，它数出每一项，把结果存成字典：每一项是一个键，次数是值，顺序是各项第一次出现的顺序。

它用起来像字典，但多了两样。问一个从没见过的键，得到 0 而不是 KeyError——文中没有 dog，counts["dog"] 就是 0。most_common(n) 交回出现最多的 n 项，是一个（项, 次数）对的列表，多的在前；次数相同的按第一次出现的先后排。这段文字里只有 the 出现不止一次（3 次），所以前两名是 ('the', 3) 与 ('cat', 1)：cat 是只出现一次的词里最先出现的。
word_count 在 Counter 外面套一层 dict(...)，交回一个普通字典，与「词频统计：先用 in 判断」「词频统计：get 带缺省值」完全一样。装着同样几对的 Counter 和 dict 比较起来相等，但类型不同；一个承诺交回 dict 的函数就该交回 dict。

lineNotes.en: dog was never counted, and a Counter gives 0 for it instead of a KeyError.
lineNotes.zh: dog 从没被数到，Counter 对它给 0，而不是抛 KeyError。

blurb.en: Sort words into groups keyed by their first letter, making sure each group's list exists before adding to it.
blurb.zh: 按首字母把词分组：往某一组里加词之前，先确保这一组的列表已经存在。

en: Grouping builds a dictionary whose values are lists: each key is a first letter, and its list holds every word that starts with it, in the order the words came.

The awkward moment is the first word of a new letter: there is no list yet to add it to. setdefault(key, default) deals with that. If key is missing, it first stores default under it; then, either way, it hands back the value now stored there. So it always hands back a real list that lives inside the dictionary, and appending to that list changes the group itself.

A dictionary keeps its keys in the order they were first added, which here is the order each letter was first met. To list the groups alphabetically instead, the program hands the dictionary to sorted, which gives back its keys in order.
Group by First Letter: defaultdict solves the same problem with a dictionary that creates missing lists by itself.
zh: 分组造出的字典，值是列表：每个键是一个首字母，它的列表装着以这个字母开头的所有词，按词出现的先后排。
麻烦出在某个新字母的第一个词：这时还没有可以往里加的列表。setdefault(key, default) 正是为这个准备的：key 不存在，就先把 default 存进去；然后无论哪种情况，都交回这个键下面现在存着的那个值。所以它交回的总是字典里那个真实的列表，往这个列表上追加就是在改这一组本身。
字典按键第一次加入的顺序保存它们，在这里就是每个字母第一次遇到的顺序。想按字母表顺序列出各组，程序把字典交给 sorted：它交回的是排好序的键。
「按首字母分组：defaultdict」用一种会自己造出缺失列表的字典解同一个问题。

lineNotes.en: An ordinary empty dictionary: every list inside it has to be created by the loop.
lineNotes.zh: 一个普通的空字典：里面的每个列表都得由循环自己造出来。

blurb.en: A defaultdict makes the missing list for you the first time a key is used, so the loop body is a plain append.
blurb.zh: defaultdict 在一个键第一次被用到时替你造出那个缺失的列表，于是循环体只剩一次普通的追加。

en: defaultdict, from the collections module, is a dictionary with one difference: when you ask for a key it does not have, instead of raising a KeyError it calls the factory it was given, stores the result under that key, and hands it back. Given list, the factory makes a new empty list each time.
So the loop no longer needs to think about new letters at all - compare it with Group by First Letter: setdefault, which has to supply the empty list itself on every call.

The function hands back dict(groups), an ordinary dictionary with the same keys and lists. A defaultdict and a dict with the same contents compare equal but are different types, and a plain dict will not quietly grow new keys when someone later reads a key that is not there.

The last three lines make that quiet growth happen on purpose. tally uses int as its factory, and int() is 0, so the missing key x starts at 0 and += 1 makes it 1. Merely reading tally["y"] also adds y with the value 0 - which is why the length is 2, not 1.
zh: defaultdict 来自 collections 模块，它是只有一处不同的字典：问一个它没有的键时，它不抛 KeyError，而是调用构造时交给它的那个工厂，把结果存到这个键下面再交回来。工厂是 list，每次就造一个新的空列表。
所以循环根本不用再管新字母了——对照「按首字母分组：setdefault」，那里每次调用都得自己递上一个空列表。
函数交回 dict(groups)，一个键和列表都相同的普通字典。内容相同的 defaultdict 和 dict 比较起来相等，但类型不同；而且普通字典不会在别人以后读一个不存在的键时悄悄长出新键。
最后三行故意让这种悄悄长键发生。tally 的工厂是 int，int() 等于 0，所以缺失的键 x 从 0 起步，+= 1 之后是 1。仅仅读一下 tally["y"]，也会把 y 以值 0 加进去——所以长度是 2 而不是 1。

lineNotes.en: Hand back a plain dict, the same type as the setdefault version.
lineNotes.zh: 交回普通 dict，与 setdefault 版本同一种类型。

lineNotes.en: Reading the missing key y creates it, so len counts it too.
lineNotes.zh: 读不存在的键 y 就会把它造出来，所以 len 把它也数进去了。

title.en: Roman Numerals with a Lookup Table

blurb.en: A dictionary turns each Roman letter into its value; one rule - a letter smaller than the one after it is subtracted - does the rest.
blurb.zh: 一张字典把每个罗马字母换成它的值；剩下的只靠一条规则：比右边那个字母小的，就减掉。

en: VALUES is a lookup table: a dictionary built once, whose only job is to answer what is this letter worth. Looking a key up in a dictionary is fast however many entries it has, and in tells you whether a letter is in the table at all - Q is not a Roman numeral, X is.

Most letters are simply added up: III is 1 + 1 + 1. The exception is a smaller letter written just before a larger one, which means take this away: in IX the I comes before X, so it counts as -1, and the total is -1 + 10 = 9. MCMXCIV is 1000 - 100 + 1000 - 10 + 100 - 1 + 5 = 1994.

So for each letter the loop needs to peek at the next one. The last letter has no next one, and numeral[i + 1] would then be an IndexError. The if puts the check that a next letter exists first and joins it to the comparison with and: when the first half is False, and stops there and never evaluates the second half.
The program trusts its input: it expects a valid Roman numeral in capitals. An unknown letter would be a KeyError from the table lookup.
zh: VALUES 是一张查找表：只建一次的字典，唯一的用处是回答「这个字母值多少」。在字典里按键查值，不管有多少项都很快；in 则告诉你某个字母到底在不在表里——Q 不是罗马数字，X 是。
多数字母只是相加：III 是 1 + 1 + 1。例外是写在较大字母之前的较小字母，它的意思是「减去」：IX 里 I 在 X 前面，所以它算 -1，合计 -1 + 10 = 9。MCMXCIV 是 1000 - 100 + 1000 - 10 + 100 - 1 + 5 = 1994。
所以循环对每个字母都要瞄一眼下一个。最后一个字母没有下一个，这时 numeral[i + 1] 会抛 IndexError。if 把「还有下一个字母」这个检查放在前面，用 and 接上比较：前一半是 False 时，and 就此停下，后一半根本不会求值。
程序信任它的输入：它假定拿到的是合法的大写罗马数字。表里没有的字母会让查表抛 KeyError。

lineNotes.en: Not smaller than the next letter, or there is no next letter: add it.
lineNotes.zh: 不比下一个字母小，或者根本没有下一个字母：加上它。

lineNotes.en: in on a dictionary asks about its keys.
lineNotes.zh: 对字典用 in，问的是键。

run.expect:
III 3
IX 9
XIV 14
XL 40
MCMXCIV 1994
MMXXVI 2026
False True

blurb.en: Two club rosters as sets: who is in either, who is in both, who is in only one, and how to add and remove members safely.
blurb.zh: 把两个社团的名单当集合：谁在任意一个里、谁两个都在、谁只在一个里，以及怎样安全地加人、删人。

en: A set is an unordered collection with no repeats, written in curly braces without colons. Four operators combine two sets into a new one: | is the union (in either), & the intersection (in both), - the difference (in the left one but not the right) and ^ the symmetric difference (in exactly one).
<= asks whether every member of the left set is also in the right one - whether it is a subset. Cara and Dev are both chess players, so that is True; Eli is not, so drama is not a subset of chess.

add puts a member in; adding Ben a second time changes nothing, because a set holds each value once. There are two ways to take one out. remove raises a KeyError when the member is not there; discard quietly does nothing. Use discard when being absent already is fine.
A set has no order you can rely on - it can come out differently each time the program runs - so show always sorts the names before printing them.
zh: 集合是一组无序、不重复的元素，写在花括号里、不带冒号。四个运算符把两个集合组合成一个新集合：| 是并集（在任意一个里），& 是交集（两个都在），- 是差集（在左边、不在右边），^ 是对称差（恰好只在一个里）。
<= 问的是左边集合的每个成员是不是都在右边——是不是子集。Cara 和 Dev 都下国际象棋，所以是 True；Eli 不下，所以 drama 不是 chess 的子集。
add 加一个成员；再加一次 Ben 什么也不变，因为集合里每个值只存一份。拿掉成员有两种写法：remove 在成员不存在时抛 KeyError；discard 则默默什么也不做。本来不在也无所谓的时候，用 discard。
集合没有可依赖的顺序——每次运行都可能不同——所以 show 总是先排序再打印。

lineNotes.en: sorted takes any set and hands back a list in order, so the output is the same on every run.
lineNotes.zh: sorted 接受任何集合、交回排好序的列表，所以每次运行的输出都一样。

lineNotes.en: <= between two sets means is a subset of.
lineNotes.zh: 两个集合之间的 <= 表示「是……的子集」。

run.expect:
either: ['Ada', 'Ben', 'Cara', 'Dev', 'Eli']
both: ['Cara', 'Dev']
chess only: ['Ada', 'Ben']
exactly one: ['Ada', 'Ben', 'Eli']
True False
drama now: ['Ben', 'Cara', 'Dev', 'Eli']
remove: KeyError

title.en: Remove Duplicates in Order: a seen Set

blurb.en: Keep the first copy of every item and drop the rest, remembering what has been met in a set.
blurb.zh: 每个元素只留第一次出现的那一份、其余丢掉，见过什么记在一个集合里。

en: Two containers do two different jobs. result is a list, so it keeps order: items go in in the order they were first met. seen is a set, used only to answer have I met this one before?
The same question could be asked of result itself, but in on a list looks through the items one by one, while in on a set is fast however big it gets. That is the only reason seen exists.
An empty set cannot be written as a pair of empty curly braces: that makes an empty dictionary - type({}) is dict, not set. The empty set has to be made by calling the set type.
Remove Duplicates in Order: dict.fromkeys solves the same problem in one line.
zh: 两个容器各干一件事。result 是列表，所以它有顺序：元素按第一次遇到的先后放进去。seen 是集合，只用来回答「这个我见过没有？」。
同一个问题也可以去问 result 本身，但 in 对列表是逐个看过去的，对集合则不管多大都很快。seen 存在的理由只有这一个。
空集合不能写成一对空花括号：那造出来的是空字典——type({}) 是 dict，不是 set。空集合只能靠调用集合类型本身来造。
「保序去重：dict.fromkeys」用一行解同一个问题。

lineNotes.en: Empty curly braces are a dictionary; an empty set needs set().
lineNotes.zh: 空花括号是字典；空集合要用 set()。

blurb.en: Dictionary keys are unique and keep their insertion order - exactly what order-keeping de-duplication needs.
blurb.zh: 字典的键不重复、又保持插入顺序——恰好就是保序去重需要的两样。

en: Given a sequence, dict.fromkeys builds a dictionary with one key for each item and None as every value. A key that turns up again is not added a second time, and every key stays where it first appeared. For Cara, Ben, Cara, Ada, Ben it builds {'Cara': None, 'Ben': None, 'Ada': None}: the keys are already the answer, in the right order.
Turning a dictionary into a list gives its keys, in order - and that is the whole answer, in one line.

Why not list(set(items))? A set removes duplicates too, but it keeps no order: its order can change from run to run. Sorting the set makes the output repeatable, but then the names come out in alphabetical order, Ada first - not in the order they were first met, which puts Cara first.
Remove Duplicates in Order: a seen Set spells out the same idea as a loop.
zh: 给它一个序列，dict.fromkeys 就造一个字典：每个元素一个键，值全是 None。再次出现的键不会加第二次，每个键都停在它第一次出现的位置。对 Cara、Ben、Cara、Ada、Ben，它造出的是 {'Cara': None, 'Ben': None, 'Ada': None}：键本身就已经是答案，顺序也对。
把字典转成列表，得到的是它的键，顺序不变——一行就是整个答案。
为什么不写 list(set(items))？集合也能去重，但它不保顺序：每次运行顺序都可能变。把集合排个序，输出是可重复了，可名字就按字母表排了，Ada 在前——而不是按第一次出现的顺序，那样 Cara 才在前。
「保序去重：seen 集合」把同一个思路用循环一步步写出来。

lineNotes.en: A set forgets the original order; sorting it gives alphabetical order, not first-seen order.
lineNotes.zh: 集合不记得原来的顺序；排序得到的是字母表顺序，不是第一次出现的顺序。

title.en: Tuple Keys for a Sparse Grid

blurb.en: Store only the grid cells that hold something, in a dictionary keyed by (row, col) tuples.
blurb.zh: 只存网格里有东西的格子：用 (行, 列) 元组作键的字典。

en: A grid that is mostly empty wastes space as a list of lists. A dictionary can store just the cells that hold something, keyed by their position. A position is two numbers, so the key is the tuple (row, col). A missing key means an empty cell, and get with a default turns that into a full stop when the grid is drawn.

Only a hashable value can be a key: roughly, a value that can never change. Tuples, strings and numbers qualify. A list does not, because it could be changed after it was put in, so using [0, 0] as a key raises a TypeError, and the program prints just the name of the exception. The same rule applies to the members of a set, which is why visited holds tuples.
in asks whether a key is there, so (1, 1) in grid is True and (1, 2) in grid is False. len counts only the stored cells: four, not the twelve cells of the 3 by 4 grid.
zh: 大部分是空的网格，用列表套列表来存很浪费。字典可以只存有东西的格子，以位置为键。位置是两个数，所以键是元组 (row, col)。键不存在就是空格子，画网格时 get 的缺省值把它变成一个句点。
只有可哈希的值才能当键：大致就是永远不会改变的值。元组、字符串、数字都行。列表不行，因为它放进去之后还可能被改，所以用 [0, 0] 当键会抛 TypeError，程序只打印异常的名字。集合的成员也受同一条规矩约束，所以 visited 里放的是元组。
in 问的是某个键在不在，所以 (1, 1) in grid 是 True，(1, 2) in grid 是 False。len 只数存下来的格子：四个，而不是 3 行 4 列共十二格。

lineNotes.en: Adding a cell is an ordinary assignment with a tuple key.
lineNotes.zh: 加一个格子就是一次普通的赋值，键是元组。

lineNotes.en: A set of tuples is sorted by row first, then by column.
lineNotes.zh: 元组组成的集合排序时先比行、再比列。

blurb.en: Two words are anagrams when they use exactly the same letters the same number of times - so count each word's letters and compare the counts.
blurb.zh: 两个词用的字母完全相同、每个字母的次数也相同，就是变位词——所以把两个词各数一遍字母，比较两张计数表。

en: letter_counts builds a tally of one word, one key per letter, with the same get-with-default line as Word Count: get with a Default.

Two dictionaries are equal when they hold the same keys with the same values. The order does not matter: listen and silent build their dictionaries in different orders, but == still says they are equal.

Counting is what makes aab and abb come out different. They have the same letters, a and b, so comparing sets of letters would call them anagrams; but one has two a's and the other has two b's. Two empty strings are anagrams of each other: both give an empty dictionary.
The program compares letters exactly as written: capitals and spaces count as letters of their own.
zh: letter_counts 给一个词造一张计数表，每个字母一个键，用的就是「词频统计：get 带缺省值」里那行带缺省值的 get。
两个字典含有相同的键、每个键的值也相同，它们就相等。顺序不算数：listen 和 silent 建字典的顺序不同，但 == 仍然说它们相等。
正是「数次数」让 aab 和 abb 分出了不同。它们用的字母相同，都是 a 和 b，只比较字母集合的话会把它们当成变位词；但一个有两个 a，另一个有两个 b。两个空串互为变位词：两边都得到空字典。
程序按原样比较字母：大写字母和空格都各算作一种字母。

lineNotes.en: repr puts quotes round each string, so an empty string comes out as '' rather than as nothing at all.
lineNotes.zh: repr 会给字符串加上引号，所以空串写出来是 ''，而不是什么都没有。
